evals.prompt: I need a professional A4 technical report for our lab (not a journal). Corporate navy #003366, numbered citations, a results table with decimal-aligned measurements, and it has to look official rather than like a student homework. Please write the preamble plus a one-page skeleton (title, one section, one table, bibliography hook). We are starting from scratch — no publisher template.
evals.expected_output: KOMA scrreprt/scrartcl + LuaLaTeX + named Brand + microtype + booktabs/siunitx S + biblatex biber numeric-comp + latexmk. No CM, no fancyhdr on KOMA, no natbib/BibTeX.
expectations: KOMA class (scrreprt or scrartcl), not article/report/book
siunitx S (or decimal align) on numeric cols

evals.prompt:
Review this table and rewrite it to publication quality. Keep the data:

\begin{tabular}{|l|c|c|}
\hline
Device & Rate (MHz) & Error \\
\hline\hline
A & 12.0 & 0.013 \\
\hline
B & 8.5 & 0.102 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

This is going into an internal technical report, not IEEE.
evals.expected_output: booktabs, no vertical rules, no double hline, siunitx S. Not IEEEtran.
expectations: siunitx S or equivalent numeric align

evals.prompt: I'm writing my master's thesis in this repo's alcazar/ template. Add a new results chapter file with one professional comparison table (two algorithms, runtime in ms, error). Do not change the document class or compiler. Also tell me the latexmk command to build.
evals.expected_output: Keep report + pdfLaTeX/latexmk -pdf -shell-escape. New table booktabs+siunitx. No scrbook/Xe/Lua switch.
expectations: Keeps report class; no scrbook/memoir switch
pdfLaTeX / latexmk -pdf (not xe/lua as required engine)
New table booktabs, not Alcazar \hline grid
